events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on White (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. White steps toward Suggs' (ORL) path and knee-to-knee contact occurs that dislodges Suggs from his position.
Queen (ORL) and Brown (BOS) reach for the loose ball and marginal contact occurs with Brown's right arm during the rebound.
Suggs (ORL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Brown (BOS).
Brown (BOS) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Suggs (ORL) prior to incidental leg-to-leg contact occurring between the two as Suggs reaches for the loose ball.
A jump ball is whistled after the ball becomes tied up between BOS and ORL.
Suggs (ORL) grabs White's (BOS) arm attempting to commit a take foul.
Suggs (ORL) makes contact with the ball before following through and the contact with Brown's (BOS) wrist is incidental.
Suggs (ORL) jumps to contest Brown's (BOS) shot attempt at the basket and the body contact that occurs is marginal.
da Silva (ORL) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot as he comes to a stop and he does not raise his pivot foot from the floor.
Queen (ORL) is losing control of the ball prior to the marginal arm to arm contact that occurs with Porzingis (BOS) during the driving shot attempt.
Boston does not request a timeout and there is an inadvertent whistle that stops play. Play resumes with Boston's possession.
Queen (ORL) initiates illegal contact to Brown (BOS) during his jump shooting motion.
